_about: Curated notes for the hiring calendar page (build_calendar.py). Observed postings come from the scan (radar_out.json + history.json on the data branch); these are the hand-checked prior-cycle examples and the pattern each organization follows. `org` must match sources.json. Dates are ISO; `cycle` is the graduating class the posting was for. Every example carries the public page it was read from.

patterns.name: Class-year pool
patterns.summary: One requisition per discipline, labeled with the graduating class ("2027 Associate", "New Graduate Engineer", "Early Career (2027 Starts)"). Posted from early summer through the fall of senior year, interviews in the fall, most offers out by January to March. Hired people are routed to teams after the offer. This is the main new-grad channel at primes, FFRDCs and the large new-space companies.
patterns.advice: Apply the week the req appears. Lockheed tells campuses that 75% of its early-career roles are filled by January and 90% by April.

patterns.name: Hire-now Level 1
patterns.summary: "Engineer I", "Associate" or "Entry Level" reqs opened when a seat is empty, with a start expected within about two months of the offer. Posted all year. For a May graduate the ones that line up with a June start appear from February onward; a fall posting is usually meant for someone who can start that winter.
patterns.advice: Keep the application profile current and treat February to May as the real season. A fall application is a long shot unless the posting names next year's grads.

patterns.name: Start-season cohorts
patterns.summary: Requisitions named for a start season ("Winter 2027", "Spring 2027") or filled on a quarterly schedule. Each cohort's req opens roughly four to six months before its start date and closes when the cohort is full.
patterns.advice: For a June 2027 start, the Spring or Summer 2027 cohort reqs appear around December to February.

patterns.name: Government labs, year-round
patterns.summary: Entry-level reqs posted continuously, often several per year for the same title, with long lead times for clearance and onboarding paperwork.
patterns.advice: Apply as early as a req appears; a four-month lead between offer and start is normal.

orgs.window: Level 1 "Entry Level" reqs appear in late winter to spring for that May's class; open windows have been as short as four days. "Associate" (Level 2) reqs carry a 1+ years line and are backfills for an empty seat.
orgs.notes: Boeing writes the level into the title and never names a graduation date: "Entry Level" means degree only, "Associate" means 1+ years, "Experienced" means 3 to 5+.

orgs.window: Early-career hiring runs September 1 through May. Lockheed tells campuses that 75% of roles are filled by January and 90% by April, and that each posting stays open about 90 days with the best odds in the first 5 to 30 days.
orgs.notes: Titles read "... Engineer Asc - Early Career" or "... - Early Career"; the level code (Asc = Associate) is Lockheed's Level 1.

orgs.window: Pooled reqs labeled with the class year ("2027 Associate Mechanical Engineer - Baltimore MD") open from late summer through November and close when filled; several 2026-labeled reqs were already closed by mid-November 2026.
orgs.notes: Unlabeled "Associate" reqs (0 to 2 years) are also entry level at Northrop, unlike Boeing's use of the word.

orgs.window: "New Graduate Engineer" reqs for the next class are posted on a rolling basis from April through October of the year before graduation, and each names the eligible classes ("graduating in 2026 or 2027"). Everything else on the board is hire-now.
orgs.notes: A standard SpaceX req with a "1+ years (internships count)" line still expects a start within weeks; students who apply to those get the generic rejection.

orgs.window: "Engineer I - Early Career (YEAR Starts)" reqs. The next year's series opens in August and September; the current year's series stays open from spring into summer for people who can start right away.
orgs.notes: The 2027 Starts reqs say "able to start by Fall 2027", so a June start is inside the window.

orgs.window: "YEAR Graduate - ..." reqs, one per group, open from July of the year before graduation and keep being added through the spring; applications are rolling.
orgs.notes: The 2026 series was still adding reqs in April 2026, so a late posting is not a sign the cycle is over.

orgs.window: "Engineer I" reqs are hire-now and appear every month. A few "(Future Grad YEAR)" reqs for the next class show up in the fall.
"Engineer I/II" reqs (0 to 4 years) open all year, often with several openings each. A pooled "YEAR College Graduate - Engineering" recruitment also runs in the spring of the graduation year.
"... Associate Engineer (Season YEAR)" cohort reqs, each posted four to six months before its start season and closed once the cohort fills.
orgs.notes: For a June 2027 start, watch for Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 cohorts from about December 2026.

orgs.window: "May YEAR New Graduate Engineer" reqs posted in September of the prior year, each naming the graduation term.
"Engineer I" reqs every month, hire-now, with a start expected within 30 to 60 days of applying.
orgs.notes: The radar shows these as Maybe with an "apply after" date computed from the start window.
